name: VPBank Hanoi International Marathon 2026
short_description: A full marathon and multi-distance race in Hanoi, Vietnam, held on October 18, 2026, organized by VPBank.
ai_summary: The VPBank Hanoi International Marathon 2026 is a full marathon event taking place on October 18, 2026, in Hanoi, Vietnam. Organized by VPBank, the race offers four distance options: 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. The race starts at Hoan Kiem Lake and finishes on Tran Nhan Tong walking street.

core_facts.venue: Start Hoan Kiem Lake, finish Tran Nhan Tong walking street

pros: Mild race morning: 21°C at the 1.30am start in 2025
AIMS-certified course that starts and finishes in central Hanoi, taking in four lakes and three bridges
Expo and bib collection beside Hoàn Kiếm Lake
cons: Marathon starts at 1.30am, in the middle of the night
Humidity sat at 94% through the night in 2025
The official site lists two different 2026 cut-offs
2026 start times and course map not yet published

excerpt_quotes.quote: VPHM năm nay là một ngày hội, không chỉ là giải chạy chuyên nghiệp có chứng nhận đường chạy quốc tế, cung đường chạy qua nhiều biểu tượng của Thủ đô Hà Nội, mà... sướng nhất là sẽ chạy ngang qua cửa nhà mình
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Writer/runner Trang Hạ, quoted in Thương Hiệu Công Luận

research_highlights: The race is held in October, in Hanoi's autumn; on race morning in 2025 (26 October) Noi Bai airport recorded 21°C and 94% humidity at the 1.30am marathon start, reaching 23°C only by 7am.
Four distances offered: 42km, 21km, 10km and 5km, all AIMS-certified; the 2025 edition drew about 11,000 athletes from 25 countries and territories.

The full marathon route weaves past four of Hanoi's lakes (Hoan Kiem, West Lake, Truc Bach, Thien Quang), three bridges (Long Bien, Nhat Tan, Dong Tru), the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, Ba Dinh Square and Thang Long Imperial Citadel.
Course descriptions consistently describe the route as generally level/flat and suitable for both competitive and novice runners, starting and finishing in the city center near Hoan Kiem Lake.
Race weekend includes ancillary events (bib pickup, pre-race concert, music stations along the course) contributing to a festive atmosphere reported by organizers and participants alike.
research_watchouts: Humidity at Noi Bai airport sat at 94% through the night of the 2025 race, so conditions can feel muggy even though the air was only about 21°C.

With roughly 11,000 participants across four distances starting from the same central area, congestion at the start/on narrow old-quarter streets is plausible given the crowded course description, though no direct runner complaint about crowding was found.

Most available English-language coverage is promotional/news-style (sponsor and organizer announcements) rather than independent runner race reports, so course-specific caveats (e.g., aid station spacing, cutoff times) are not well documented in what's publicly available.

faqs.question: When is the VPBank Hanoi International Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The VPBank Hanoi International Marathon 2026 takes place on Sunday 18 October 2026 in Hanoi, according to the official site. It is the seventh edition organised by VPBank, with four distances, 42 km, 21 km, 10 km and 5 km, starting at Hoàn Kiếm Lake and finishing on Trần Nhân Tông walking street.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The event offers four distance options for participants to choose from: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a 5km race, allowing runners of different experience levels and fitness goals to take part.

faqs.question: Where does the race start and finish?
faqs.answer: The race starts at Hoan Kiem Lake, a well-known landmark in Hanoi, and finishes on Tran Nhan Tong walking street. This route takes participants through central areas of the city as part of the VPBank Hanoi International Marathon 2026 course.

faqs.question: How much does registration cost?
faqs.answer: The official site lists Standard prices of VND 1,668,000 for the 42 km marathon, VND 1,268,000 for the 21 km half marathon, VND 988,000 for the 10 km and VND 668,000 for the 5 km. Bibs for the 2026 race are distributed through the CTicket platform, according to the organiser.
